analysis: The supplied units are documentation-only additions to CHANGELOG.md (head text, lines 397-608+). No code, configuration, or mode/rename metadata changes are visible. The entries describe App Attest recovery (T-053, T-054, T-057), CandidateCDHash binding to durable build qualification (T-054, A-017), first-grant reassert retries, and SSD prefix-cache defaults. They state that fresh assertions, receipt verification, revocation checks and qualification are still required, so no weakening is claimed. The changelog also reports that the SSD disk budget (available-disk/2 with no fixed ceiling and a 20 GiB reserve) matches the T-041 posture. The T-041 text mentions a 30-minute TTL; this is consistent with the changelog as far as the supplied excerpts show. The changelog's Bonsai SSD default-on entry and Gemma QAT/GPT-OSS default-on entries are consistent with T-041's default-on per-donation gating, but the underlying code was not supplied, so I cannot verify them. The next pass should check the implementing code, which is not in this batch: the CandidateCDHash 20-byte-to-32-byte uniqueness matching, the recovery after a recorded frame refusal, and the inventory-backfill race repair. Those code paths bear on T-053/T-054/T-036 and need the real source for review. Nothing in these two units alone is a security regression.
